<thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 121.0528 most plausibly corresponds to a molecular ion of formula C₇H₅O₂ (or its protonated form C₇H₆O₂⁺). This fits the observed isotopic pattern (≈8 % M+1, consistent with ~7 carbons) and the exact mass within typical instrument tolerance.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H5O2</final_answer>
